scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-sample identity and sharp eta-to-zero equivalents; the Student-ratio identity is classical and not asserted novel. Independent validation null step is modeled explicitly. No global optimization trajectory claim.
scientific_limitations: Isotropic additive Gaussian noninterpolating expectation-oracle model; first two iterations at the population minimizer with zero initial scaling; independent fresh batches, scalar bounded scaling, exact arithmetic. Relative-gradient-noise guarantees in motivating paper do not apply.
title: Sharp dimension-dependent null-step risk for Gaussian out-of-sample hypergradient scaling
